text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Spring—the season of the Classics has arrived. I draft a plan of what races we'll take on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, we watch some videos of races featuring Triple Crown champion Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While watching Narita Brian race, I think about how unfortunate it is that Mayano Top Gun doesn't have such a rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I can't stop watching the videos of Narita Brian. Mayano Top Gun becomes jealous and yells at me to keep my eyes on her and her alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then sets a goal of defeating Narita Brian in a legitimate race with the apparent intention of keeping my attention all for herself.
